name: market stall with striped red awning and fruit baskets on the counter
label: pirate-isles/pi-stall-fruit

answer.evidence: The counter top surface spans rows 15 to 20 (about 6 px deep) on which the fruit baskets rest, with the south counter face below spanning rows 23 to 31. The awning canopy also slopes down towards the viewer in standard 3/4 perspective.

answer.main_body: market stall counter and sloped awning
answer.evidence: The striped awning roof slopes down over rows 0-13, and the counter displays a clear 6-row horizontal top surface (rows 16-21) upon which the fruit crates sit, before dropping into the vertical front panel (rows 22-31).

The counter surface is visible from row 16 to row 21 (around 5-6 rows of depth) where three fruit crates/baskets sit, with a front rim at row 21-22 and a vertical front face extending to row 31. The awning slopes down toward the viewer.

The counter table top is visible across rows 16-21 (approx. 6 rows of depth) where fruit crates rest, above a vertical south-facing wooden panel front (rows 22-31). The canopy roof also shows its sloping top surface.
